title:
POV: I GAVE FLOWERS TO A
STRANGER IN JERUSALEM 🇮🇱
beats: HOOK + GIFT + JOY, one POV take: opens on her face as the yellow flower arrives ('Happy holiday' - her mouth opens in surprise at 6-7s), 'for health and joy', 'thank you so much'; strangers join in and a girl kneels with a red rose (14-18s); 'what is this? you made me so happy!'; her caregiver beams 'that's how it should be'; then 'where were you born? - Morocco - Casablanca?'. 'Excuse me, this is for you' (4.3s) is left out: the frame before 5.4s is an empty street [framing: manual full-height centre crop - the auto face-aim put the crop top-left on passers-by in V1 r1]

WIDE, observer iPhone: the whole scene - her in the wheelchair holding the bunch of flowers, Tal crouched at her level, caregiver behind. Covers the pause while she thinks (POV there is a whip-pan blur at 40s). POV audio underneath so the sound is continuous. Proxy only (360p). Exact sync of the two cameras NOT measured - this is a cutaway, not a matched moment

THE BOND + GOODBYE: 'Rabat!' - 'yalla, I'm Iraqi', hands going as she talks, 'nice to meet you', 'be healthy', 'bye, my love' over the caregiver's smile. Ends before the whip at 51s [framing: manual full-height centre crop - the auto face-aim put the crop top-left on passers-by in V1 r1]
